Toad Economics

Buy Taxes (7%)

  • 2% Token Burn
  • 2% NFT Staking Pool
  • 1% Liquidity Pool
  • 2% Treasury

Sell Taxes (7%)

  • 2% Token Burn
  • 2% NFT Staking Pool
  • 1% Liquidity Pool
  • 2% Treasury

Token Burn

A token burn is built into Digi-Toads, immediately creating a deflationary factor. This means our fixed max supply becomes a constantly decreasing circulating supply, creating scarcity on the number of TOAD tokens, forever!

NFT Staking Pool

TOAD holders need rewarding! Every transaction adds 2% of TOAD tokens to the staking rewards. These rewards are paid to staked TOAD NFTs, cycling TOAD back to the most dedicated Toad-ficionados.

Treasury

The Treasury also plays a role in stocking up the staking pool, supporting TOAD’s constantly deflationary model, furthering development, and keeping the liquidity pool topped up to ensure users can join and leave the swamp freely!
